components.name: Primary Button

components.name: Ghost Button

components.name: Danger Button

components.name: Search Input
components.description: Boxed field on field-white with edge outline.
components.css: .ds-input { width:260px; min-height:40px; padding:6px 10px; border:1px solid #6f8f75; border-radius:3px; background:#fdfefb; color:#16241c; font:14px 'Hanken Grotesk Variable','Segoe UI',sans-serif; transition: border-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-input::placeholder { color:#54665a; opacity:.85; } .ds-input:hover { border-color:#16241c; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #1f3fae; outline-offset:0; }

components.name: Navigation Item
components.description: Rail link; active state is a field fill with inset edge outline.
components.css: .ds-nav { display:flex; align-items:center; min-height:36px; padding:0 10px; border-radius:3px; color:#54665a; text-decoration:none; font:550 14px 'Hanken Grotesk Variable','Segoe UI',sans-serif; transition: background-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1), color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-nav:hover { background:#e1eadc; color:#16241c; } .ds-nav.on { background:#fdfefb; color:#16241c; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px #6f8f75; } .ds-nav:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #1f3fae; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Filter tab; pressed is solid ink.
components.css: .ds-chip { min-height:28px; padding:0 9px; border:1px solid transparent; border-radius:3px; background:transparent; color:#54665a; font:600 13px 'Hanken Grotesk Variable','Segoe UI',sans-serif; } .ds-chip:hover { background:#e1eadc; color:#16241c; } .ds-chip[aria-pressed='true'] { background:#16241c; color:#f6f8f3; } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #1f3fae; outline-offset:2px; }

narrative.overview:
Clipvault is a filled-in Indian bank or passport application: pale dropout-green stock, hairline green rules, square boxed fields, and exactly one pen, a ballpoint blue. The numbers people come for (Aadhaar, PAN, bank accounts) are set one character per square box, and the same boxes carry every number in the product. It is calm and dense, a form somebody has already completed, not a grey three-pane clipboard tool.

Blue is the only action ink. Red appears only for expiry, hidden-until-asked warnings and destructive actions. Everything else is green-tinted neutral. Corners are 2-3px, captions are sentence case, and depth comes from rules and outlines rather than shadow. The dark scheme (follows prefers-color-scheme) is the same form at night: green-black stock with a light periwinkle ink.
keyCharacteristics: Dropout-green neutrals, never grey; one blue ink for action and focus.
One character per box wherever a short number is shown; tabular figures.
Square 3px corners, 1px outlines, hairline rules, sentence-case captions at 12.5px.
Flat at rest; shadow only on the toast (and the PDF page sheet).
Light and dark are both first-class and token-swapped, not inverted.

rules.name: The One Pen Rule
rules.body: Blue is the only action color. It marks what you can do or what was just written, never decoration.

rules.name: The Red Is a Warning Rule
rules.body: Red appears only for expiry, hidden-until-asked and destructive states, and always with words or an icon beside it.

rules.name: The Sentence Case Rule
rules.body: Captions are sentence case at 12.5px semibold; no uppercase, no tracking.

rules.name: The Outline Not Shadow Rule
rules.body: Selected and active states are a 1px edge inset outline, not a lift.

dos: Do set any short number (IDs, bank numbers, OTP-like values) in comb boxes with tabular figures.
Do use Ballpoint Blue for the one primary action per view, focus, and the "written" copy moment.
Do use 1px edge outlines, 3px radius and hairline rule dividers for structure.
Do provide every color a night counterpart through the same token name swap, and keep reduced-motion fallbacks.
Do pair red and blue status with words or icons.
donts: Don't use grey neutrals; every neutral is green-tinted.
Don't add shadows to cards, rows or panels; flat with outlines.
Don't use blue for decoration or red for anything other than expiry, warnings and destructive actions.
Don't use uppercase, tracked captions or other labels above headings.
Don't introduce pill radii or larger-than-3px corners.
